title: 饺子配米饭

lines.text: 山田在日本的时候，最爱吃的就是煎饺，而且每次都要配一碗米饭。
lines.py: Shān tián zài rì běn de shí hou, zuì ài chī de jiù shì jiān jiǎo, ér qiě měi cì dōu yào pèi yì wǎn mǐ fàn.
lines.en: Back in Japan, Yamada's favourite food was fried dumplings, and she always had them with a bowl of rice.
